items.title: Fantasy Castle
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Explore this large fantasy themed castle, while being accompanied by rideable dragons!

+ Great for roleplay
+ A huge castle and village, with full interior to explore
+ Fly around on dragons
+ Dragons come in 3 different colors, as both babies and adults

items.title: Valhalla Vikings
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Vikings are fierce and extremely powerful! Become a mighty warrior or a creepy mythical monster when you equip one of these skins. Roleplay as a Valhalla viking with your friends!

- 17 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Candy Treats HD
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Ever wanted to be an ice cream, a chocolate bar or any other sweet? 
With this skin pack now you can!
+ A free skin!
+ 10 HD skins!

items.title: Among Imposters Infected
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
The imposters have been infected and are more dangerous then ever!
Have fun with these colourful skins.

One free skin!

items.title: Mythical Gods!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The Mythical Gods have arrived in Minecraft with glowing white eyes!
Become a super-powerful god and bring destruction or save the world!

+ 12 Mythical Gods skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes male and female Mythical Gods skins!

items.title: Graystone Keep
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Tour this epic town and discover all the things to do and see. Explore the keep with your friends or stay in one of the town's inns as a traveler. Adventure awaits daring soldiers, brave citizens, peaceful farmers, and regal nobles in this town with a place for everyone!

- Farming settlements
- Town with keep and rooms for everyone
- Hidden treasury with loot
- By BTWN

items.title: City Gangsters
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The City Gangsters are back in town! Join them and conquer the city!

- 8 stunning skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Cyberpunk 2078
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
In 2078 everything is totally different! Now it's time for you to find your way in this crazy world!

- 10 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Blazing Volcano
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A firestorm of poisonous vapors and molten debris engulfed the surrounding area spewing tons of molten ash, launching pumice and sulfuric gas miles into the atmosphere. Explore the dangerous wasteland of the Blazing Volcano!

-Stunning survival spawn
-Nether portal
-By RareLoot

items.title: Surreal Skyblock - Chapter 1
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Finding yourself on a floating island in the sky you are forced to survive and slay the mighty dragon. Will you be able to find all 31 Treasure Chests, that wait for you in the depths to the island and castle? Will you even be able to find the entrance to the end? 

- Surreal Skyblock
- Geometric world
- By Bumblesaurus

items.title: Anime University
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
It’s time for school in the world of anime!
These teens are ready to go back to school in a stylized world where anything can happen. From the dorms to the coffee shops to hanging out in the city, there’s nothing these characters aren’t ready for!
Check out these eight fantastic skins!

items.title: Karate Bricks
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Practice with wood planks is over, this class of martial artist is constructed from bricks! Build up your skills with these concrete methods, blow down the competition’s straw houses, and fight with the very earth in your attacks! This training style requires strong muscles, stronger technique, but once you’re done these 15 stone skins will rock every battle!

items.title: Cartoon Heroes
items.creator: House of How
items.description: This city needs a hero! Where the strong oppress the weak, where the sick seek aid, where villains face no consequences for their actions, who will be there? You have the opportunity, you have the power, all you need now is your costume. Put on the mask, gear up and make a difference! This heroic pack contains 15 supercharged skins in stunning color!

items.title: Randomized Mobs
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Everything in town is a little different than usual. Mobs can have random sizes and features! Sheep can explode like creepers, creepers can be docile like sheep! Can you keep up with all of the changes? Let's try it out!

+ Mobs gain random attributes and sizes
+ Many places to explore
+ Fully furnished village and castle
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Cyberpunk Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Welcome time traveler! You finally reached 3057. Mechanical eyes, laser glasses, robotic arms, what else do you need to enjoy the future? Of course you need some amazing skins!

- 12 skins
- By Street Studios

items.title: Cute Animals 2
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Want to be a cat, a dragon or a panda?
In this second volume these adorable pets will make your heart melt even more. Includes an extra version with a top for each animal, so you won’t get bored of your new skin!

+ 22 colorful skins
+ Great for roleplaying!
+ By LuckOfTheSea

items.title: Icons
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Ready to set a new trend in the city? Then become an icon! Enjoy unique colorful and modern outfits! These teens are binge-watching anime or hopping around on a skyblock world. Get ready to wear the latest fashion styles!

- 12 skins for teens
- Modern, cool, and cute
- 1 free skin

items.title: Crazy Mask
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Try one of these 'Crazy Mask' skins on for size. Perfect for any situation. Need to hide your identity? Maybe even blend in with everyone at a masquerade party. No? Ok well sometimes you need to stand out! Whatever the situation, this pack has got you covered. Come on by and try out one of these crazy skins you won't regret it!

- 6 masked skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Hardcore Chaos
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
You've got one life to live! Welcome to a unique take on the classic Hardcore Mode. The world has periodic curses, such as levitation, falling gravel, lava pits, and more. How long can you survive?
-35 unique events to survive
-Snarky poetry
-Great for a speedrun challenge
-Survive alone or with friends in multiplayer

TNT rain, lightning, and falling anvils; oh my!

items.title: Cartoon Faces
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Ultimate noob vs pro cartoon faces! Each skin has an unique face expression and looks super funny! Who are you? The noob or the pro? Choose it yourself! Play together with your friends and use these skins for fantastic roleplay.

+Amazing for roleplay!
+Male and female options!
+Amazing for YouTube videos!

items.title: 0 Block Challenge
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Are you ready for this new challenge? Start your skyblock survival with 0 blocks! This is even harder than the 1 block challenge! Can you figure out how to survive and beat the game?

+Unlock skyblocks!
+Infinity random drops!
+You start with 0 blocks!
+Hardcore skyblock experience!
+Great for singleplayer and multiplayer!
+Skyblocks in the overworld and nether!

items.title: Future Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
These teens come from the future and they bring the cyborg technology to your worlds!

+ 12 futuristic characters, equipped with the latest sci-fi clothing and accessories.
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Emoji High School
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: How are you feeling today? tired? sad? hungry? excited? in love? With 15 different emoji faces to choose from and a total of 25 skins, these teens aren't afraid to show it. Express yourself! Let your truth be known with this High School-themed emoji skin pack.

items.title: Modern Sports
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: No noobs here! These teens are training as the brightest star in their sport. What kind of pro athlete are you? Gymnast, diver, rower, wrestler, skateboarder, weightlifter? With these 10 motivating, skins, you sport them all!
